visual_review_note: Inspected the final revision2 color-contour overlays at ten actual planes (including first/last and worst reported contour errors), front/side/top/isometric silhouettes, wall contact sheet, and worst-point close-ups. measurement_note: Fresh subprocesses were used. Validation, audits, rendering and briefly duplicate cancelled workers ran concurrently with some benchmarks; wall-clock values are contextual rather than isolated throughput claims. The final zero/.02 controlled comparison uses .16/.08 in both models and the same unmodified first-width/thin-wall/elephant-foot profile settings.
scope: Local file generation and slicing only; no physical print, upload, or printer action.

result.method: Rotate dominant external downward hull-bottom plane to negative Z; center XY at 135 mm and ground minimum Z. Prepared before any weaving; original source unchanged.

limitations: No native slicer or wall-path comparison is run by this stress suite.
